annotations.title: China Expat IIT, Social Security Cap & BIA Net Pay Engine

description: Compute annual and monthly net take-home cash, marginal brackets, employer costs, and tax savings from eight Fapiao-backed BIA allowances across six Chinese cities.

annualBonus.description: Separate annual lump-sum bonus taxed under MOF/STA Announcement 2023 No. 30.

childrenEducation.description: Accredited international school tuition reimbursed per period with official invoices.

cityId.description: Municipality determining local social insurance base caps and employer rate tables.

currency.description: Reporting currency code used for base pay, BIA items, and returned net figures.

grossAmount.description: Base cash remuneration expressed in the chosen currency before payroll deductions or tax.

housingRental.description: Fapiao-substantiated housing rent allowance matching the chosen incomePeriod and currency.

incomePeriod.description: Specifies whether grossAmount and BIA inputs are monthly or annualized figures.

socialSecurityMode.description: Select exempt for Shanghai opt-out or treaty protection, otherwise standard capped contributions.
